check: 1a every schema field has a default
detail: 10 sections, 58 fields

check: 1b a configuration round-trips through disk
detail: saved and reloaded identically, nested parameters included

check: 1c posted settings are typed, and anything unknown is dropped
detail: rows became 25000, symbols 'BTCUSDT ETHUSDT', an invalid frame and an unknown field were both refused

check: 1d a hyperparameter left at its library default is not passed
detail: min_samples_leaf 300 kept; max_depth 8 and num_leaves 31 dropped as defaults; an unknown estimator refused

check: 2a the in-house oscillators do not swallow the pandas-ta block
detail: f_ta_ selected f_ta_x alone, leaving f_ta_pta_y out; they are different libraries and one prefix is a prefix of the other

check: 2b families, then names, then exclusions last
detail: f_wc_ gave two, a named column was added, an exclusion removed one, and a name not in the frame was ignored

check: 2c nothing ticked offers everything
detail: 7 of 7 columns offered

check: 3 a symbol matches whichever form it is written in
detail: BTCUSDT, BTC/USDT, btc/usdt and BTC-USDT all reduce to the same key

check: 4a always predicting the base rate returns a Theil U2 of exactly one
detail: U2 = 1.000000000000. This is the definition and it is the reference every other U2 in the repository is read against

check: 4b that same forecast is perfectly calibrated and useless
detail: MISE 0.000e+00, bias share 0.000e+00, RMSE 0.4325. MISE near nought for a model that says nothing is why it is read beside RMSE and never instead of it

check: 4c MAPE does not exist on a nought-or-one outcome
detail: reported as None rather than computed on the rows where the outcome is one, which would be a different quantity from the one the name promises

check: 4d the bias share matches its closed form on a known shift
detail: a forecast shifted +0.30 gives a bias share of 0.324881 against the closed form 0.324881

check: 4e a perfectly calibrated spread forecast scores near nought on MISE
detail: MISE 0.00009 where the outcome was drawn from the prediction itself, so the calibration curve is the diagonal

check: 4f the overfit ratio is cross-validated over training, not the reverse
detail: identical predictions give a ratio of 0.9891 against a bar of 1.1

check: 5a the separation measures stay inside their bounds
detail: overlap 0.5542, Hellinger 0.3988, both bounded on nought to one by construction

check: 5b a constant forecast separates the classes not at all
detail: overlap 1.0, at or near one, which is the reading for two classes that are indistinguishable on the predicted range

check: 5c the spread measure detects a model that never leaves the base rate
detail: 90 per cent span 0.00e+00, mass within 0.05 of the base rate 1.000

check: 5d the sensitivity table is produced for every kernel number
detail: five bandwidths from half Silverman's rule to twice it; overlap moves 0.0151 across them on this well-spread sample

check: 5e the null band is well formed
detail: 60 permutations, the lower edge never above the upper

check: 5f the null band tells signal from noise
detail: a model whose outcomes came from its own predictions sits outside the band over 92.5 per cent of its range; one whose outcomes are independent of them sits outside over 0.5 per cent. That gap is the whole purpose of the band
